col_4: An Experienced Professional is a new member who joins FiftyFive Technologies as a full-time employee and possesses a minimum of six (6) months of prior relevant work experience at the time of joining the Company.
The probation period is a mandatory period which every experienced professional who joins FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited should undergo before he or she is confirmed as a permanent employee.
Confirmation for an experienced employee is an event that marks the end of the probation period wherein the experienced professional is confirmed as a permanent employee.
